note.en: The signed-in service accepted a world-history research brief and a focused chronology request. Both remained at generating a research plan during preparation. No Gemini report or unsupported AI findings were adopted.
note.zh: 已登录服务接受了世界史研究纲要及针对编年的请求；准备期间均停留在生成研究计划阶段。未采用尚未返回的Gemini报告或无来源支持的AI结论。

researchService.evidencePolicy: Historical evidence comes from the individually cited sources and their disclosed retrieval limits.

method.en: All three planned editorial releases are represented by selected regional, social and biographical batches. This records published scope, not exhaustive coverage or independent verification of the full inherited collection. Political dates do not authorize boundary geometry. Source notes distinguish full-page inspection from indexed evidence where retrieval failed.
method.zh: 以精选区域史、社会史与人物批次覆盖三个计划编辑阶段；记录实际发布范围，不表示完整覆盖或已独立核实全部继承资料。政治年代不构成疆界依据。来源说明在读取失败时区分全文检查与索引证据。
